يستطردوا (form X)
# يَسْتَطْرِدُوا (yastaṭridū) /jas.tatˤ.ri.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
# يُسْتَطْرَدُوا (yustaṭradū) /jus.tatˤ.ra.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَطْرَدَ (istaṭrada)
